rows.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, category and origin page
rows.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, gateway and set services, and its pages copied from the finished live-animals feature folders plus the germinal differences. This row lays that set down and proves it with its first page: a trader who chooses Germinal products on the type question, or Create new on the INS germinal products list, gets a new Draft notification with a GBN-AG reference, stored with the category germinal products, and lands on the germinal set's own copy of the origin page. Each set opens only its own category's notifications, the set's root hands on to the INS germinal products list, and every germinal page carries the shared service chrome pointed at the germinal set. The germinal set's checks run inside the existing animals Playwright project.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing 'Germinal products' on 'What are you importing?', or 'Create new' on the INS germinal products list, creates a new notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip, and lands on the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048, -p1-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p13-004)
No germinal products notification is ever given a reference starting GBN-GP. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-124)

The germinal origin page asks the same questions, with the same heading, hints, options and error messages, as the finished live-animals origin page, and saves its answers to the germinal notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-001-m1)

The stored notification record holds the category germinal products for a draft the germinal set creates; a record with no category is read as live animals, so every live-animals notification stored before this change still opens in the live-animals set. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-001, repo-backend-p3-015)

Saving, submitting, amending, cancelling an amendment and copying a notification through the backend never change its stored category. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-001)

From a live-animals draft, going back to 'What are you importing?' and choosing 'Germinal products' starts a new germinal products notification with its own reference; the live-animals draft keeps its answers and its live-animals category. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-054, -p1-055, -p1-056)

Opening a germinal products notification through a live-animals page, or a live-animals notification through a germinal products page, shows the page not found page and changes nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-092, repo-frontend-p1-134)

Visiting /germinal-products shows no notification list and sends the trader to the INS germinal products list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-034, -p1-113; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-014)

Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with Dashboard, Address book, Manage account and Log out, the Alpha phase banner, the footer and the title '<page> - Import notification service - GOV.UK'; the service name and Dashboard lead to the germinal set's home, Dashboard is the current item on every page inside a germinal notification, and an error on a germinal products address is shown in the germinal set's chrome. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006 to -p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006, repo-frontend-p1-010, repo-frontend-p1-011, repo-frontend-p1-048-m1)

The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run in the existing animals Playwright project, with no new project: the accessibility checks hold each germinal page to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the suite's existing axe rules, and the security scan drives the germinal pages. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-061, -p1-062, -p1-063; repo:tests repo-tests-p6-001, repo-tests-p6-090)
rows.gate: Look at the germinal set's skeleton (its mount, root hand-off, chrome, category on the stored record, the cross-set guard and its copied origin page) before the other germinal page copies follow it: every later germinal row copies a live-animals feature folder into this set the same way.
notes: Combines the set's own slices: the set and its mount (req-1780), the draft and its reference (req-1781), the category on create and on the record (req-1856, req-1884, req-1885), the cross-set guard (req-1901), the root hand-off (req-1851), the chrome (req-1907) and where the set's specs live (req-1806). Each needs the same new set, gateway, router mount and backend category, and none is observable apart: the origin page is the one page that proves them together. Option B plan section 2 calls this inc-173.
Sam's ruling (claim 58) makes the germinal set one theme, germinal-products, in the last wave; this row is its first and every other germinal row depends on it.
The live half of the cross-set guard is a small row in journey-foundation by the plan; the guard here reads the stored category in both directions.

The origin page's Back link by context (req-1740) is not drafted here: its template-review clause needs germinal template mode, so the combiner places it with that row. The certified-for answer set on create (req-182) is reason-and-additional-details' requirement; its storage sits in the same create path, so the combiner may merge it here.
The INS germinal list (inc-141), the type question's Germinal option (inc-148) and returning to the type question from a live draft (inc-150) land in earlier waves, as ruling claim 53 allows.

rows.title: The germinal commodity search offers V4's germinal products, and only them
rows.detail: The germinal set's 'What are you importing?' page is the finished live-animals page with a germinal hint and its own catalogue. Following V4's germinal data fields and the 9 October ruling, the catalogue holds V4's germinal commodities with embryos and ova as separate items, each offering the species Design Release 2.1 lists, and the live-animals catalogue gives up the 12 germinal lines it holds today, so neither set offers the other's commodities. Searching and ticking behave as the live-animal search does.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal 'What are you importing?' page keeps the live-animals title, caption, heading, ITAHC inset, label, buttons, Cancel link and Back link to the origin page, and its search hint reads 'You can search for semen, ova or embryos, or by common name (for example, cattle), Latin name (Bos taurus) or commodity code (05119985).' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-058; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-097)

The germinal catalogue holds 18 items, sorted by name, codes shown with their leading zero: Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep each as '<Animal>, Embryos' and '<Animal>, Ova' (05119985); 'Cattle, Semen' (05111000); and 'Cat, Semen', 'Dog, Semen', 'Goat, Semen', 'Horse, Semen', 'Pig, Semen', 'Rabbit/Rodent, Semen' and 'Sheep, Semen' (05119985). There are no Cat or Dog embryos or ova and no poultry, fish or bee germinal products. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-050 to -p1-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-037, -p1-038; conflict c-230 default)

Each germinal item offers the species Design Release 2.1 lists for its animal: Cattle offers Bison bison, Bos taurus and Bubalus bubalis, with Bovidae as well for semen; Horse offers Equus asinus and Equus caballus; Goat Capra hircus; Pig Sus scrofa domesticus; Sheep Ovis aries; Cat Felis catus; Dog Canis familiaris; and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen one row labelled Rabbit/Rodent. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138 to -p2-155-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-061, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-062)

Searching 'semen' lists the eight semen commodities in name order (Cat, Semen; Cattle, Semen (05111000); Dog, Semen; Goat, Semen; Horse, Semen; Pig, Semen; Rabbit/Rodent, Semen; Sheep, Semen), offering 12 species rows, and the live region announces '12 results available'; Cattle, Semen offers 'Bovidae' and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen offers 'Rabbit/Rodent' as group rows. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-059 to -p3-062; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098)

Ticking Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under Cattle, Semen shows '1 selected' with a 'Cattle, Semen (05111000):' line and a 'Bos taurus' chip, as the live-animal search does. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-063)

The germinal search finds no live-animal commodity: searching 'cattle' offers only the cattle embryos, ova and semen items. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-059)

The live-animals search never offers semen, embryos or ova: searching 'semen', 'embryos' or 'ova' on a live-animals notification finds nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098)
openQuestions: c-230: does the germinal catalogue hold only V4's 12 germinal commodities, or also Design Release 2.1's Cat and Dog embryos and ova? Default, followed here: V4's 12 with embryos and ova split and 'Semen - Dog or Cat' shown as separate Cat, Semen and Dog, Semen, 18 items; Cat and Dog embryos and ova are not offered.
notes: Combines the page copy (req-069), the catalogue (req-093), the search results (req-1782), the selection panel (req-1783) and the split of catalogues (req-092): one page, one catalogue, one review. Depends on the draft row 'A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, category and origin page' in this area.

req-092's live half (taking the 12 germinal lines out of the live-animals catalogue) is also restated as req-1754, which the option B plan puts in inc-012; the combiner keeps whichever row it gives req-1754 and this row's live criterion together, so the live catalogue file is changed once.
The germinal catalogue is the set's own commodity service, a copy of the live-animals one, with its own as-you-type route (inc-014's constraint, c-012). Reference data serves no commodity list.
The GBN-AG typeCode per product type (req-1800) is carried by the Commodity details row, where the backend first stores a germinal line.

rows.title: The germinal opening run and main import reason: two reasons and four purposes
rows.detail: A germinal notification runs from origin through 'What are you importing?' to 'Main import reason', as live animals does. The germinal set's copy of the main import reason page offers only Internal market and Transit, and Internal market reveals only four purposes, each with the live-animal wording. A reason or purpose outside these lists is never saved.
acceptanceCriteria: Started from the INS germinal products list, the germinal origin page shows only 'Save and continue', and its Back link returns to the germinal products list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-053, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-054, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-056; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-096)

Saving the germinal origin page goes to the germinal 'What are you importing?' page, and saving a germinal selection there goes to the germinal 'Main import reason' page, in the order live animals uses. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099)

The germinal main import reason page asks 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' with only Internal market and Transit, in that order: Internal market hinted 'For imports of animals intended for sale or use in Great Britain (England, Scotland or Wales).' and Transit with its live-animal hint; the page ends with Save and continue, Save and return to overview and 'Cancel and return to overview'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-065 to -p3-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-100)

Choosing Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market' with only Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Research and Production, in that order, each with its live-animal hint. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-068; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-101)
Submitting a purpose outside those four with Internal market shows 'Select a purpose in the internal market', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-065)
Submitting a main reason outside Internal market and Transit, such as Re-entry, saves no reason: reopening the page shows nothing chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-074)
notes: Combines the germinal opening run (req-127) with the germinal reason lists (req-169, req-170, req-1799): the run ends on the reason page, and one germinal walk proves both. Ruling claim 24 drops every mixed-load criterion inc-024 carried, and the germinal set leaves the Additional details page out (its row is 'The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier').

Depends on the draft rows 'A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, category and origin page' and 'The germinal commodity search offers V4's germinal products, and only them' in this area.
The origin Back link for other contexts (the type question, the overview, the template review) is req-1740, placed by the combiner.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the backend stores them
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Commodity details asks, for each chosen species, an optional 'Total gross weight' in kilograms and a 'Number of packages', and always asks one optional 'Temperature' for the consignment. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row. The animals backend stores the gross weight as a decimal and the temperature on every line, and shows them back; neither is published, because the current PIMS profile (gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0) has no field for them. A germinal notification is published on the same GBN-AG events as a live-animals one, each trade line carrying the typeCode for its product type.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal species block asks 'Total gross weight' in a narrow text input with the suffix 'kg', before 'Number of packages'; left blank it shows no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-011; conflict c-232)

Each germinal species block asks 'Number of packages', with no hint and no '(when required)', and never asks the number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-032, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-034; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-033)

After all commodity blocks the page always asks one 'Temperature' radio question, its legend at label size rather than a heading, hint 'How will the products be stored', options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen in that order; left unanswered it shows no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-039, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-034; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-019 to -p1-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; conflict c-232)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Bos taurus'; its block is headed '<name> (<code>)', such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)', and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-031)

A saved total gross weight such as 24.5, the number of packages and the temperature are shown again when Commodity details is reopened; the backend holds the weight as that species line's gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal, and the temperature on every commodity line of the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022, -p1-040, -p1-042; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-006, -p1-012; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-039, repo-backend-p1-040, repo-backend-p1-043, repo-backend-p1-044; conflict c-022)

The GBN-AG notification the backend publishes for a germinal notification uses the same events and payload as a live-animals one: each trade line's quantity is its number of packages, it carries no gross weight and no temperature, and it leaves out unweaned animals, CPH number and permanent address as it leaves out any unanswered section. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-041 to -p1-043; repo:backend repo-backend-p6-001, repo-backend-p6-033; conflict c-234 default)

In that published payload each germinal trade line carries the typeCode SEMEN for a semen item, EMBRYO for an embryos item and OVA for an ova item, and embryos and ova are always separate trade lines. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-038; repo:backend repo-backend-p6-109; conflict c-273)
openQuestions: c-234: is a germinal line's quantity its number of packages or its total gross weight in kilograms? Default, followed here: the page asks both; 'Number of packages' is the line's quantity, published as v0.2.0's whole-number quantity, and 'Total gross weight' is the line's gross weight in kilograms, stored as a decimal and not published.
notes: Combines the three questions (req-121, req-123, req-124), the selected commodities row (req-125), their storage (req-122, req-1889) and what is published (req-1800, req-1895): one page copy and one backend change to the species line and the GBN-AG mapper. Ruling claim 43 overrides the option B plan's v0.3.0: neither trade-imports-schemas nor trade-imports-dynamics-gateway changes for the germinal set.
c-022 (ruled): the answer is a gross weight, not the prototype's netWeight key. c-232 (ruled): weight and temperature are optional, with no blank errors.

Depends on the draft rows 'The germinal commodity search offers V4's germinal products, and only them' and 'The germinal opening run and main import reason: two reasons and four purposes' in this area. inc-017's live halves (req-114, req-126) moved to inc-012 under the option B plan; this row keeps only the germinal content, so it keeps inc-017's id.

Where publishing is observed: GBN-AG is published from the backend outbox on submit, so the two publishing criteria are observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload, before the germinal declaration page is copied.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages, listing errors by question
rows.detail: V4 caps the germinal total gross weight at 1,000 kg to 2 decimal places and above 0, and makes the quantity mandatory to proceed, up to 1,000. Design Release 2.1 counts packages in whole numbers from 1 and gives the messages it has; the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern. The error summary lists every weight error before every packages error. Valid answers continue as the journey says.
acceptanceCriteria: A Total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-008)

A Total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-007, -p1-048)

A Total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 is accepted; one with more than 2 decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-009, -p1-012; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

A blank Number of packages shows 'Enter the number of packages', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-015)

A Number of packages that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037)

A Number of packages over 1,000 shows 'Number of packages must be 1,000 or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-014, -p1-016, -p1-018; conflict c-234 default)

With errors on several species, the error summary lists every Total gross weight error, species by species, before every Number of packages error; Temperature never appears in it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-057; conflict c-232)
openQuestions: c-234: the default makes 'Number of packages' the line's quantity under V4's Quantity rules (required, whole number, 1 to 1,000); this row builds the 1,000 limit on that default.
notes: Split from the Commodity details questions row so neither is too big to review in one sitting: this row is the page's validation and error order, that row is its questions and storage. Depends on the draft row 'Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the backend stores them' in this area.
c-232 (ruled): the prototype's blank-weight and blank-temperature errors are not built.
The overview's Commodity details Complete rule for germinal (req-1763) needs the germinal hub copy, so the combiner places it with the germinal hub row.

rows.title: Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified once per species, whatever their number of packages. The germinal set's copy of Identification details shows each germinal species one editable form with V4's four optional fields, saved by the page's own buttons and prefilled with what was saved. The quantity column reads 'Number of packages'. The animals backend stores the four fields and shows them back; none is published, because gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 has no field for them.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid germinal Commodity details continue to the germinal Identification details page. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-038)

The page's Selected commodities quantity column is headed 'Number of packages' and shows each species' saved number of packages. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-070, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-067)

Each germinal species panel keeps its species heading and a 'Change number of animals' link to Commodity details, worded as for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-071)

Each germinal species shows one editable form headed 'Enter details for <species>' with no count, such as 'Enter details for Bos taurus', whatever its number of packages, with no panel button and no saved-entries table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-069; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054)

The form asks 'Donor name/ID' (text), 'Collection date', 'Production date' and 'Identification number/mark' (text), in that order, for every germinal commodity in the catalogue. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-018, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-072 to -p5-075; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-026, -p1-031, -p1-036, -p1-041, -p1-049)

Values typed into each germinal species' form are saved by the page's 'Save and continue' and by 'Save and return to overview', and are shown prefilled when the page is opened again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-049, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-083)

The backend stores the donor name or ID, the collection date and the production date (each a date-only YYYY-MM-DD value) and the identification number or mark for each germinal species, and the GBN-AG notification it publishes carries none of them. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040, -p1-042, -p1-046, -p1-047; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-046, repo-backend-p1-047)
notes: Combines the step from Commodity details (req-1790), the packages column (req-1776), the panel heading and link (req-262), the one-form panel (req-250), its four fields (req-251) and their storage (req-1892): one page copy and one backend change, proven by one germinal walk.

Where the donor details sit on the record (per-line identifier entries, as GBN-AG has them, or the species line) is decided in the build from the real model, not the prototype's shape (ruling claims 46 and 47).

req-252 (the two date fields as single text inputs with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026') is germinal-only but areas.json gives it to animal-identification; the combiner should merge it here, with inc-052, where it sat before.
Depends on the draft row 'Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the backend stores them' in this area.

rows.title: Germinal dates get the date picker, and the identification fields their length and date checks
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives each germinal date a 'Choose date' calendar (the MOJ date picker). V4 caps Donor name/ID at 58 characters. Dates accept one- or two-digit day and month, any real date past or future, are not checked against each other, and read back as entered. An invalid submission shows its errors in field order in the standard GOV.UK way.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle opening a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-064)

A Donor name/ID over 58 characters shows 'Donor name/ID must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline; 58 characters is accepted. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-077; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-056; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-027)

A collection date of 1/9/2026, a production date in the past or in the future, and a production date earlier than the collection date all save with no error and read back exactly as entered. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-081; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-062; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-035, -p1-040)

A submission with several invalid germinal fields re-renders the page with the error summary listing its errors in field order (Donor name/ID, Collection date, Production date, Identification number/mark), each linking to its own field, which is shown in error with its message inline. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-080, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-084; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-059)
notes: Split from the germinal identification row so neither is too big to review in one sitting: this row is the fields' validation and the date picker, that row is their shape and storage. Depends on the draft row 'Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them' in this area.

The date format, real-date and Identification number/mark length errors (req-255 to req-259) are germinal-only but areas.json gives them to animal-identification; they sat in inc-053 with these, and the combiner should merge them back here so the germinal date checks land together.
The MOJ frontend package is already a dependency of the frontend.

rows.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
rows.detail: The germinal set leaves out the Additional details page: its overview has no Additional details task, and a valid identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, but V4 needs at least one germinal identifier: a germinal species counts as identified, for the overview's Complete status and for submit, once its entry holds at least one of the four.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview has no Additional details task: its section 2 holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-150; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details; opened from its overview task, the review or the template review, it returns there instead. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank shows no missing-value error and never stops 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-060; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-028, -p1-033, -p1-038, -p1-043)

The overview's Identification details task shows Complete only once every selected germinal species, a lone species included, has at least one of the four identifiers saved; the identification page shows no message for this rule. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-071, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-086)

Submitting a germinal notification with a species whose entry holds no identifier is refused, and it submits once that species has one identifier. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-085)
notes: Combines the missing Additional details step (req-181) with the one-identifier bar (req-261): both are the germinal set's flow and obligation rules around identification, and both can only be observed once the germinal hub, review, template review, Arrival details and declaration copies exist. Kept apart from the identification page rows so those build early.

Depends on the combiner's germinal copies of the hub (req-1836), the review (req-1843), template mode (req-1876), Arrival details (req-1898) and declaration and submit, and on the draft row 'Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them' in this area. inc-099 and inc-105 hold the germinal hub and review differences today.
Ruling claims 188 and 189: one identifier is enough, with one bar for Complete and for submit.
